d: What are tectonic plates and how do they move? In this video, we explain plate tectonics in simple words — from the structure of the Earth (core, mantle, lithosphere) to how massive rock slabs float on semi-molten mantle, driven by convection currents. Learn about Pangaea, the three types of plate boundaries (divergent, convergent, transform), how the Himalayas were formed, why earthquakes happen, and how plates move at the speed your toenails grow.
